Dear Requester

I have been forwarded your email below.

I am afraid I do not understand the request you are making. Your email says it is following up a preservation notice of 28 September 2026, but we have not seen any communication or document from you on that date. We have the enquiries you have sent to us on 19 and 21 September 2026, but yours is a matter on which this firm is unable to assist. Your requirement for a firm which can deal with a matter in which you seek reparations for historic human rights violations means we do not have the expertise your matter will require.

In answer to your questions below, we do not hold anything relating to this matter apart from what you have sent us, which you will be able to obtain from your own ‘sent items’ in your email account. This firm was not established until 2002, and we have never been instructed in relation to the land in question, so we do not hold anything from the 1986/87 proceedings you refer to and have no physical or electronic files from that date or about the land which we would be able to search.

Kind regards

Patrick Murphy

Dear Darwin Gray,

Re: my preservation notice of 28 September 2026.

I am writing about Great House Farm / Tŷ Mawr, Llandough-juxta-Penarth, Vale of Glamorgan, the subject of BP Properties Ltd v Buckler (High Court 1986; Court of Appeal 1987). I have not yet had a substantive reply to my notice, so I am following it up.

I would be grateful if you would tell me:
1. whether Darwin Gray holds any file, report, correspondence or data relating to Great House Farm / Tŷ Mawr, the 1986–87 proceedings or the
1988 demolition of the farmhouse;
2. what searches were made, and whether any physical files were checked; 3. whether anything has been destroyed or transferred elsewhere (and if so, when and to whom).

A reply by 16 November 2026 would be much appreciated. Please also make sure that no record relating to Great House Farm / Tŷ Mawr is destroyed while these enquiries are open.

Thank you for your help.

Yours faithfully,

Requester
